formal_object.rationale: Positive matched total masses define entropic unpaired OT and row-normalized barycenters.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: D02: pi=diag(u)exp(-C/eps)diag(v) with fitted marginals. Condition: Positive masses with equal total and eps>0 H02: Transport fit alone cannot identify semantic class correspondences. Condition: Class symmetries preserve available statistics

derivation.rationale: Gibbs factors follow marginal multipliers; normal equations yield the ridge map; semantic permutation gives an identifiability boundary.

assumptions.rationale: Transport uses train-only features; release labels are not intentionally discarded to create an artificial unpaired problem. Regularized OT is strictly convex for positive compatible masses, but semantic correspondences may be unidentifiable. A geometric cost needs actual cross-modal comparability and stable class proportions. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: The conditional coupling-to-ridge construction is explicit. A genuine unpaired task is still absent and legal pairing must not be removed to make one.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Benefits require independently justified geometric identifiability; class proportion or symmetry shifts should expose failures before any claim of general semantic alignment. Falsification: Paired Procrustes or simpler nearest-neighbor alignment uses legal available information and matches the result; semantic permutations make correspondence ambiguous.

closest_alternative.rationale: Sinkhorn barycentric mapping and paired Procrustes are known alternatives; there is no new semantic-identifiability theorem. This check only reviews the stated mathematical comparison; exhaustive full-text/author-code/native collision and originality decisions remain pending.
